description: ignorePaths restates the :ignoreModulesAndTests default (part of config:recommended) minus '**/tests/**': the postgres custom manager below must see backend/tests/fixtures/db_provider.py, which the default ignore silently excludes.

Renovate is by far the largest consumer of this repo's Actions minutes, so rebaseWhen and platformAutomerge below are set purely to stop it from multiplying CI runs. rebaseWhen 'conflicted' replaces the default 'auto', which rebases every open Renovate branch whenever main moves — with several automerging PRs open at once that cascades: each merge re-triggers CI on every other open branch. platformAutomerge hands merging to GitHub's own auto-merge, so Renovate does not push extra commits (and extra CI runs) just to land a branch that is already green. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/noise-reduction/

packageRules.description: This is an application (frontend is private, backend is a deployed service — neither is published for others to install), so Renovate best practice is to pin runtime deps to exact versions rather than float SemVer ranges (https://docs.renovatebot.com/dependency-pinning/). :pinDevDependencies already pins frontend devDependencies; this rule extends exact pinning to the frontend runtime 'dependencies' that still carry '^' ranges. Scoped to frontend/package.json so it does not rewrite the backend's '>=' floors, which intentionally rely on uv.lock as the real pin. The global rangeStrategy stays 'bump'.
Auto-merge dev tooling (linters, formatters, type checkers, test libs) on minor/patch — these break loudly in CI, not silently in prod.

Auto-merge backend dev-group tools (ruff, ty, pytest, import-linter, etc.) on minor/patch. The depType is 'dependency-groups' — the name Renovate's pep621 manager gives the whole PEP 735 [dependency-groups] table (https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/pep621/) — not the group's own name 'dev', which never matched.

Auto-merge GitHub Actions on minor/patch; majors still get a manual review PR. 'pin' is included so it matches the 'github actions' batching group below exactly — a group whose members disagree about automerge does not automerge at all, and pinning an action already in use to its current digest changes nothing.
Auto-merge pre-commit hook bumps on minor/patch.

CI-minute control: batch every GitHub Actions bump into one PR. Action updates are mostly digest re-pins from helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests and arrive several at a time; as individual PRs each one costs a CI run on its branch plus another on main once it automerges. The shared-pin groups below still override this for the pins they own.

CI-minute control: batch dev tooling (linters, formatters, type checkers, test libs, build tooling) into one PR. These already automerge on green, so a single grouped PR lands the whole week's tooling in one CI run instead of one per package.

CI-minute control: batch backend runtime minor/patch bumps into one reviewable PR. These deliberately do NOT automerge (they ship to prod), so grouping trades one weekly review for one CI run instead of a run per package.

the shared-pin rule (docs/dependencies.md): keep every uv pin identical. Group the PyPI pin (setup.sh, pyproject [tool.uv], CI), the Docker builder image, and the mise toolchain pin into one PR so they always bump together.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep every Postgres image pin identical (docker-compose + the two Python literals) — a mismatched image risks false migration diffs. One grouped PR. postgres-backup-local's '18-alpine' tag must track the postgres major, so it rides in the same group.
Group Node runtime pins (mise, frontend Dockerfile, setup-node) so the runtime version bumps in a single reviewable PR.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep every pnpm binary pin identical — mise.toml, package.json 'packageManager', and the CI setup-pnpm 'version' input (via the custom manager below). One grouped PR. Excludes the pnpm/action-setup action itself, which is a separate version stream handled by the github-actions manager.

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): keep the hadolint binary pin identical across the pre-commit hook (.pre-commit-config.yaml rev) and mise.toml. Excludes hadolint/hadolint-action, a separate action version stream.
Major runtime/image and framework bumps are review-only: no automerge, explicit label so they surface on the dashboard.

customManagers.description: Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): Postgres image tag hard-coded as a Python string literal in the migration generator and the integration-test fixture (not visible to the docker-compose manager).

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): hadolint image tag in the cloud setup script — both the prepull list and the Docker-backed shim it installs (hadolint has no native install channel in that environment). Feeds the 'hadolint' group above so it bumps together with mise.toml and the .pre-commit-config.yaml rev.
Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): uv version pinned as a PyPI package in the cloud setup script and in pyproject [tool.uv] required-version.
Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): uv version passed to astral-sh/setup-uv in CI (a workflow input the github-actions manager does not touch).

Shared pin (docs/dependencies.md): pnpm version passed to pnpm/action-setup in CI (a workflow input the github-actions manager does not touch). Kept explicit because v6 can't read packageManager from a subdirectory package.json (pnpm/action-setup#227). The optional comment groups tolerate the trailing '# v6' that helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests adds to the pinned 'uses:' line.
